_comment: FALLBACK ONLY. The supported Python range of an Odoo series is an Odoo source fact, read from the checkout by odoo_source_facts.py (python_support / python_recommendation): MIN_PY_VERSION/MAX_PY_VERSION, else setup.py python_requires, else debian/control or the launcher shebang. This table is consulted only when no checkout is readable (e.g. before the core repo is cloned). 'min'/'max' mirror those source facts (max null = the source declares no upper bound); 'recommended' is an editorial pick, used only while it lies inside the source range. 'python2' marks series that require Python 2.7. A new series needs no entry here - the source range covers it.
